programme.title: Episode 3

programme.title: Episode 4

programme.title: GROSSEST House Flip We've EVER Done

programme.title: A Game-Changing Sustainable Development
programme.desc: The need for a new development model is desperately needed, a model which is sustainable and financially accessible with a focus on townhouses in urban locations.

programme.title: A Minimalist Interior That Gives a Lesson in Tiny Apartment Design
programme.desc: Architect Douglas Wan wanted something simple for his own tiny apartment, avoiding the fancy gadgetry often found in tiny homes.He thought about how he might want to live in the apartment, with the idea of living a monastic life but in the city.

programme.title: This Mid-Century Home Has Been Simply Updated for an Art Lover
programme.desc: Amanda is an avid art collector and curator, but her Mid-Century home in Ormond was becoming small, and the need for more space for both her art and family was paramount.

programme.title: This Home is The Definition of Good Architecture
programme.desc: What defines good architecture and ultimately a well-designed home?If there was ever a perfect example it’s One MANI House by Mani Architecture.This home takes a difficult, narrow site and uses it to create an adaptable, flexible, four-bedroom home that is filled with unexpected moments, beautiful design details and lots of natural light.

programme.title: An Architect's Own Family Off-Grid Sustainable Home
programme.desc: Melbourne architect, Jerry Wolveridge of Wolveridge Architects, bought the rural property of his clients, and after a study of local agricultural buildings, decided to design a simple, timber-clad pitched off-grid home.

programme.title: This Home is The Definition of Good Architecture
programme.desc: What defines good architecture and ultimately a well-designed home?If there was ever a perfect example it’s One MANI House by Mani Architecture.This home takes a difficult, narrow site and uses it to create an adaptable, flexible, four-bedroom home that is filled with unexpected moments, beautiful design details and lots of natural light.

programme.title: A Home Renovation and Extension that Embraces the Garden
programme.desc: While out walking her dog, Melbourne architect Fiona Dunin of FMD Architects, stumbled across a 1920's Californian bungalow in Melbourne's southeast and attended the auction.

programme.title: The Modern Family Beach House of Architect-Duo
programme.desc: Taking cues from the relaxed 'beach house' vibe, the home of Topology Studio's Amy Hallett and Darren Kaye took a rundown Victorian and started fresh to create an opportunity to springboard their architecture practice.

programme.title: 6 Dowel Joinery Tips
programme.desc: Here's 6 beginner woodworking tips for improving your wood dowel joinery, when the dowels are visible.I'm using mostly 6mm oak dowel rod but these can also apply to fluted dowels.

programme.title: I Almost Finished Making This Urn In Time
programme.desc: This is my second successful client commission since going full time as a woodworking business.I've learned a lot through this process and document it all in this video.

programme.title: I THOUGHT this would only take 5 hours to make
programme.desc: It didn't.The client who commissioned this high chair go the deal of a life time.As a new furniture maker I'm learning that being a woodworker does not make you a good CEO overnight.

programme.title: I'm Building a Home Office With Acoustic Walls
programme.desc: I'm a furniture maker building a home office in an unused corner of my workshop.

programme.title: Sustainable Floating Tiny House Made From Cardboard!

programme.title: Cycling In The Netherlands: Off-Grid Cabins
programme.desc: We’re setting off on a short cycle trip across the Netherlands to check out some of the country’s leading innovations.From an off-grid cabin in the De Biesbosch National Park called Cabin Anna, to the Innovative city of Eindhoven where 2023 Dutch Design Week is showing off the latest in green tech and sustainable innovation.

programme.title: The Future of Fashion
programme.desc: What if you could turn bacteria into sustainable clothing dyes!Colorifix is creating sustainable clothing dyes by recreating the DNA of colors found in nature.

programme.title: Leoncito Alado
programme.desc: LEONCITO ALADO es un canal de canciones infantiles para niños de 1 a 3 años de edad.Aquí podrás encontrar canciones para tranquilizar, entretener y enseñar valores y talentos a nuestros pequeños espectadores.

programme.title: El Mundo de Luna
programme.desc: Curiosa por todo y entusiasmada por la ciencia, Luna, de 6 años, y su hermano Júpiter y su mascota Clyde exploran la naturaleza para conocer el mundo.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends
programme.desc: Talking Tom descubre que su ciudad ha descendido al segundo lugar entre las ciudades mas amistosas, y el y la banda deciden que tienen que ser mas acogedores.

programme.title: Angry Birds
programme.desc: ¡Echa un vistazo a las recopilaciones de Angry Birds Toons!Cada recopilación contiene varios episodios de tus series favoritas, como Angry Birds, Piggy Tales y Stella.

programme.title: Alex y el Mar
programme.desc: Alex vive en una isla y se prepara cada mañana un desayuno mientras Rocco y Lili juegan juntos.Un científico holográfico aparece en una máquina y le dice a Alex cual es su misión para el día: Alex ha de fotografiar un delfín.

programme.title: Pintxo Contra el Cambio Climatico
programme.desc: Pintxo es un duende travieso, junto a él nos divertiremos y jugaremos en casa mientras respetamos nuestro planeta y hacemos frente al cambio climático.

programme.title: BarryTiger
programme.desc: BarryTiger es una serie animada en 3D vibrante y cautivadora, diseñada para niños de 1 a 8 años, que da vida a aventuras cotidianas a través de música pegajosa y encantadora.

programme.title: Domi Kids
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes.

programme.title: Discovering the Ancient Grottoes of Chongqing
programme.desc: The third episode of the Chongqing Series, Humanistic Chongqing, focuses on the Dazu Stone Carvings in Chongqing.In 1999, the Dazu Stone Carvings were inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 1
programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN’s Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, “Fun Guide to China”.Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.4
programme.desc: Gansu, in China's northwest, is a land dominated by tremendous forces of nature: mountain ranges flanking north and south press to form the ancient Hexi Corridor, and, of course, the mighty Yellow River.

programme.title: Suzhou Fans
programme.desc: Suzhou, known as the “Venice of China,” is also famous for its traditional crafts.And one of the most elegant and exquisite crafts is Suzhou fans.Celebrated for their exquisite design and fine quality, they’re popularly associated with literati.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking.Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage.The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving.Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan.This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere.

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting.Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people.

programme.title: Inner Mongolia’s Frozen Wonderland
programme.desc: In this episode, we feature the Winter Nadam Fair and winter sports in Hulunbuir, Inner Mongolia.By late December, the Hulunbuir Grassland is blanketed in ice and snow.

programme.title: Exploring the Long Winter
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Jingpo Lake, Xuexiang and Yabuli in Mudanjiang, showcasing the unique winter ice fishing festival, the fairytale-like scenery of Xuexiang, and its world-class ski resorts.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.5
programme.desc: Guangdong, sheltered by the Nanling Mountains, is a province where rivers cascade from hills on their way to the ocean.But before they meet the sea, they pass through another land of plenty, a place where solid earth encounters the rolling waves in a truly loving embrace - the Pearl River Delta.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc.

programme.title: A Touch of Speed: The Art of Wing Chun
programme.desc: Uncover the principles of Wing Chun, a unique Chinese martial art renowned for its efficiency and directness.This program explores its legendary origins, core concepts like the center line theory, and its practical application in close-quarters combat.

programme.title: Diabolo
programme.desc: In China, the diabolo has a history of over 600 years.From the earliest uniaxial design, it developed to have a double axis.With time, it came to be made in various shapes and from various materials.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.
